metaTitle: Custom Purple Luggage ID Tags | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Shop custom purple luggage ID tags for bulk orders. Make your bags stand out with a vibrant, branded tag. Get a quote at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Purple luggage ID tags offer a distinctive way to identify your company's travel gear or promotional giveaways. Unlike standard black or red tags, purple stands out on baggage carousels and helps prevent lost luggage. Choose from durable plastic or leather-look materials with custom imprinting in your logo or text. Ideal for corporate travel sets, employee gifts, or trade show giveaways, these tags combine visibility with brand recognition.
heroAltText: Custom purple luggage ID tags with logo imprint, featuring a rectangle shape and sturdy strap for attaching to suitcases.
